hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[^[:alnum:]])(git[[:space:]]+push|gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create)' || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && bash scripts/pr-self-review.sh --hook

p=$(jq -r .prompt); for m in client server reviewer-core e2e; do f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/$m/INSIGHTS.md"; if printf '%s' "$p" | grep -qiE "$m" && [ -f "$f" ] && ! grep -q 'No entries yet' "$f"; then echo "== $m INSIGHTS =="; cat "$f"; fi; done

f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ddigest-ins-$(jq -r .session_id)"; [ -e "$f" ] && exit 0; touch "$f"; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Before finishing: run the engineering-insights WRITE step. If this session produced a substantial, non-duplicate gotcha/footgun/root-cause, append it to the touched module INSIGHTS.md (dedup first). If nothing clears the bar, say so and stop."}'
